claim.excerpt: A simple and reliable method was developed using LC-MS/MS to quantify alprazolam, bromazepam, clonazepam, diazepam, and flunitrazepam in clinical samples.

sources.title: Development and Validation of an LC-MS/MS Method for the Simultaneous Determination of Alprazolam, Bromazepam, Clonazepam, Diazepam and Flunitrazpam in Human Urine and Its Application to Samples from Suspected Drug Abusers

why_it_matters: Links the substance to an analytical technique; does not imply a validated method for any laboratory.
